description: Everything the directory holds about one venue: how you get on a court, booking route, price, courts, surfaces, floodlights, hours, indoor play, coordinates, and the source each fact was read from, with the date it was read. Takes the slug returned by find_courts, and its city.

city.description: Which city, one of: nyc, melbourne, london, paris, toronto, washington-dc, madrid, miami, sydney, palm-springs-california (nyc is New York City). Defaults to nyc when left out; the reply says which city it answered for.

slug.description: Venue slug, e.g. central-park. From find_courts.

name: get_court
title: Full detail for one place to play
